immutable_baseline.root_heading: R08 — P1 — GE cartridge media/intervals and housing-size mappings conflated

scope_note: This packet adjudicates authoritative GE truth for FXWPC (media, pleated characterization, interval, 2.5-inch class) and GXWH20S edges required to resolve FXWPC conflicts. Full R08 closure also includes FXHTC interval and GXWH20S→FXHTC size-class mapping; those are listed as sibling scope, not re-opened here for implementation.

fxwpc_media_type.statement: GE FXWPC is a whole-house sediment reduction cartridge (sand/sediment; 30 µm nominal particulate). It is not a carbon cartridge.

fxwpc_pleated.statement: GE documents FXWPC construction as Pleated (GXWH20S manual element chart; GE filter-element specification chart 49-50043-3).

fxwpc_vs_fxwtc_carbon.statement: For GXWH20S-class 2.5-inch elements, GE lists FXWTC (Rev. 2) as Carbon Paper chlorine reduction — not FXWPC. BuckParts must not label FXWPC as carbon.

fxwpc_replacement_interval.statement: GE replacement guidance for FXWPC: 3 months or 16,000 gallons (whichever comes first per OEM spec tables).

fxwpc_physical_class.statement: FXWPC is a 2.5-inch × 9.75-inch cartridge class per GE parts spec dimensions.

gxwh20s_default_vs_fxwpc.statement: GXWH20S ships with FXUSC (Rev. 2) polypropylene sediment filter. FXWPC is documented as an alternate Pleated sediment element in the same function/life class — not the in-box default.

gxwh20s_fxwpc_recommended_mapping.statement: Repo mapping ge-whole-house-gxwh20s → ge-fxwpc (is_recommended=true) is plausibly defensible as an OEM alternate sediment cartridge, but only after customer-facing copy stops calling FXWPC carbon and uses 3-month interval. Prefer not elevating FXWPC above FXUSC without explicit staged recommendation policy.

gxwh20s_fxhtc_mapping.statement: Recommended mapping ge-whole-house-gxwh20s → ge-fxhtc conflicts with FXHTC 4.5-inch spec vs GXWH20S 2.5-inch cartridge family in manual. Hold or demote pending separate R08 repair tranche — out of FXWPC identity-only apply.

executive_decision.governing_truth_fxwpc: GE FXWPC (OEM part FXWPC) is a 2.5-inch-class whole-house Basic Replacement Water Filter for sediment/sand reduction (~30 µm nominal particulate), pleated construction, with OEM service interval of 3 months or 16,000 gallons. It is not a carbon filter; GE assigns carbon/chlorine reduction for this housing size class to FXWTC (Rev. 2), not FXWPC.
explicit_non_decisions: Do not adjudicate full R08 FXHTC copy, chlorine claims, or all GXWH20S mapping demotions in the FXWPC identity tranche
Do not mass-edit other GE model→FXWPC mappings (gxwh30c/35f/40f) beyond shared CSV row and notes that repeat the carbon error
Do not treat retailer/marketplace carbon labels as authority over GE OEM specs
